text: The Patriots have themselves a signature win: they traveled to Buffalo's new Highmark Stadium and knocked off the Bills 29-26 in Week 4, with Drake Maye orchestrating a game-winning drive to silence Josh Allen and hand Buffalo their first defeat at home in their sparkling new facility. Maye, who had stumbled out of the gate this season, shook off an early-season slide with a clutch performance that included three touchdown passes despite coughing up two turnovers—a reminder that the kid didn't need to be flawless to get the job done when it mattered most. Coach Mike Vrabel is apparently highlighting this victory as critical for the defending AFC East champions, and already the hot-take industrial complex is spinning up with overreaction pieces questioning whether the Patriots are truly back on track for another division title, whether certain contenders have their mojo returning, or whether other heavyweights are in genuine trouble. The good news for New England is that all six of their questionable players—including Dre'Mont Jones, Craig Woodson, and Eli Raridon—suited up for the trip, meaning the roster stayed intact for this crucial road test against a division rival.
